post.summary: Bulk weigh multiple shipment items with the same product
post.description:
This endpoint handles weighing all items with the same product at once, by:
1. Finding all chosen items for this product in the shipment
2. Distributing the weight proportionally based on each item's requested quantity
3. Recording the weights for each item and its chosen product
4. Updating all items to COMPLETED status

get.summary: Get available items for weighing in shipments
get.description:
Returns a list of items that are ready for weighing across all shipments.
These items have been marked as "CHOSEN" and are grouped by product to facilitate
bulk weighing operations.

shipmentId.description: ID of the shipment containing these items

requestedQuantity.description: Total requested quantity for all items with this product

shipmentItemIds.description: IDs of all shipment items included in this group

post.summary: Transfer items dari pengiriman selesai ke customer baru
post.description: Membuat DO baru dengan mentransfer item dari DO yang sudah selesai dalam suatu shipment ke customer yang berbeda. Kuantitas item di DO asli akan dikurangi sesuai jumlah transfer.

sourceShipmentId.description: ID shipment yang sudah selesai (status SELESAI)

quantity.description: Jumlah yang akan ditransfer (tidak boleh melebihi completedQuantity)

message.example: Item berhasil ditransfer ke customer baru

400.description: Bad request - validasi gagal atau transfer tidak memungkinkan

403.description: Forbidden - tidak memiliki permission TRANSFER_ITEMS pada resource shipment

post.summary: Kurangi kuantitas item dalam shipment yang sudah selesai
post.description: Mengurangi kuantitas item dalam shipment yang sudah selesai (biasanya karena truk kelebihan muatan). Kuantitas yang dikurangi akan dikembalikan ke pendingQuantity di DO asli. Fitur ini untuk koreksi post-shipment, tidak memerlukan regenerasi dokumen.

shipmentItemId.description: ID shipment item yang akan dikurangi kuantitasnya

newQuantity.description: Kuantitas baru (harus lebih kecil dari kuantitas saat ini)

message.example: Successfully reduced quantity by 25. 25 units moved back to pending.

updatedShipmentItem.description: Data shipment item yang sudah diperbarui

updatedDeliveryOrderItem.description: Data delivery order item yang sudah diperbarui

400.description: Bad request - kuantitas baru tidak valid atau terlalu besar

403.description: Forbidden - tidak memiliki permission REDUCE_ITEMS pada resource shipment

404.description: Not found - shipment item tidak ditemukan
